core_exploratory_findings: The full-valid search contains several recurring CMB-transverse axis families rather than one unique spacing.
A clean spectral-polarization axis and a 31-position angular-variance axis are 84.391 degrees apart; their cross product is 0.0364 degrees from the supplied CMB axis.

A broadband combination direction is within 1.30% in reciprocal-vector norm of qA+2qB, but the residual accumulates about 146 cycles over the full CMB translation; this is transverse-vector grammar, not absolute phase registry.
The combination direction qC has projected-velocity reversals near turns 1134.45 and 1810.15. Slow PC extrema occur within several turns in two different valid channel regimes.
The 445/Clear/NIR bridge rotates from a strongly common short-period state toward a two-mode ultraslow state with broad quadrature and antipodal relationships.
The initial ten-channel slow phase graph is ordered by photon energy and contains strong blue-to-NIR opposition plus a near-quadrature 555-NIR edge.
Low-order two-axis Fourier-lattice terms describe more of the clean mid/slow multichannel state than either direct axis alone, indicating sum/difference modulation.
Strong sideband triads obey frequency-addition relations, while measured phase-amplitude modulation is present but modest.
Angular within-turn harmonics and slow rectilinear modulation are coupled only weakly in direct complex regression; they remain distinct multiplex layers.
